cost_impact: 11 rounds took 58% of H1 2026 capital; the median round is €2.0M; no new unicorn since 2023 ([Dealroom 2025](https://www.spaincap.org/storage/documents/2025/06/the-spanish-tech-ecosystem.pdf)).
driver_status: a market force (supply of capital and of fund investors). Policy proposals (scale-up certification, support for startup listings, a "TIBI" model for institutional capital) are **not enacted** ([Dealroom/Kfund, June 2025](https://www.spaincap.org/storage/documents/2025/06/the-spanish-tech-ecosystem.pdf)).
software_solvable: Partly. Investor-readiness tools (data rooms, KPI reporting, investor CRM and matching) help. The shortage of capital is structural.

title: Public funding (ENISA, CDTI Neotec/PID/LIC, EIC) is slow, conditional and paperwork-heavy
who: pre-seed to Series A tech startups and university spin-offs, especially R&D-heavy deeptech; Neotec is for companies under 3 years old.
where: national (ENISA, CDTI), plus regional agencies such as ACCIÓ, IVACE, SPRI, ICF, AvalMadrid, SODERCAN and IDEPA, listed by [Tetuan Valley](https://tetuanvalley.com/blog-financiacion-publica-para-startups/).
reality:
founders spend weeks on business plans, technical reports and financial projections.
- ENISA requires own funds at least equal to the loan, and filed or audited accounts.
- Neotec requires at least €20k of share capital and a budget of at least €175k.
- Money arrives 3–9 months later.
- Credit lines and funds keep changing: the old ENISA lines were replaced, and the FEPYME fund is drawn down as loans are approved.
scale: thousands of firms (7,800 ENISA borrowers cumulatively). A single public pot of €303M (FEPYME).
cost_impact: 3–9 months of delay. Adviser fees are not published. Many firms pay a fractional CFO (€750–€2,000 a month) to build the financials.
solved_today: specialist consultancies (for example the Premoney and Tetuan Valley partnership; fees not public), accelerators, fractional CFOs, ENISA's client portal.
software_solvable: Partly. Eligibility pre-checks (own-funds rule, age, capital), document assembly, financial-model templates, a calendar of calls and tracking of post-award reporting are automatable. Approval stays discretionary.
confidence: Medium-high. Several sources agree, but timing data comes mostly from advisers.

title: R&D tax credits, cash refunds, binding R&D certificates and researcher Social Security rebates are underused
who: R&D-intensive startups (deeptech, biotech, AI), often still making losses, from seed to Series B.
where: national (tax agency AEAT and Ministry of Science). The evidence base is strongest for Catalonia.
reality: to claim, startups must document R&D projects and staff time, ideally obtain a binding R&D certificate (Informe Motivado Vinculante), and decide whether to cash in the credit at a 20% discount. Many skip it because they are making losses. The innovative-SME label (Sello Pyme Innovadora), valid for 3 years, is needed to combine credits with Social Security rebates for researchers.
scale: inference: about 2,100 of the 2,403 Catalan startups invest in R&D (89%).
cost_impact: a 20% discount on credits taken as cash. Consultant fees were not found. Credits are lost if not documented (inference).
driver_status: the R&D deduction and cash-refund rules of the corporate-tax law (Ley 27/2014), the binding-certificate rules (RD 1432/2003) and the researcher rebate (RD 475/2007). **Presumed in force; not re-verified in the BOE in this session.** Overlaps with the tax researcher.
solved_today: R&D tax consultancies (fees not verified), binding certificates through the ministry's process, in-house timesheets.
software_solvable: Yes or partly. R&D time-tracking, project documentation and claim packs suit software. The certificate remains a public step.

title: Day-one fixed costs and filings: autónomo registration and quota, VAT from the first euro, quarterly returns
who: every founder-director who controls a new SL. Hardest for pre-revenue, bootstrapped and pre-seed founders.
where: national; the complaint is voiced by AES in Madrid.
reality: on incorporating, a founder who controls the company must register as self-employed (autónomo) and pay the quota. They must charge and declare VAT "desde el primer euro" (from the first euro) and file quarterly returns "desde el minuto uno" (from minute one). In practice they hire a gestoría before they have any revenue.
evidence:
- Mateo: "Hemos normalizado un atraco a mano armada a los emprendedores desde el día uno"; "la burocracia es enorme"; Spain does not apply the €85,000 VAT exemption (his claim) — [El Diario de Madrid, 9 Dec 2025](https://www.eldiariodemadrid.es/articulo/entrevistas/carlos-mateo-asociacion-startups-emprendimiento-innovacion-espana/20251209125147115994.html).
- "la obligación de que una persona se dé de alta como autónomo en el momento en el que crea una sociedad" (having to register as autónomo the moment you create a company) is a major barrier — [Computerworld, 23 Dec 2025](https://www.computerworld.es/article/4111037/carlos-mateo-la-inmensa-mayoria-de-startups-que-hay-en-espana-son-tecnologicas.html).
- AES asks to eliminate the autónomo quota and exempt the first €85,000 from VAT — [AES manifesto](https://asociacionstartups.es/); [Telemadrid, 16 Apr 2026](https://www.telemadrid.es/programas/madrid-trabaja/Madrid-se-consolida-como-referente-de-emprendimiento-y-el-sector-exige-menos-burocracia-9-2880401945--20260416044908.html).
- The law only relieves founders who also hold a job elsewhere: a 100% rebate on the minimum-base quota for up to 3 years — [BOE](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2022-21739).
- Among all entrepreneurs, 5.6% of closures are attributed to "Políticas fiscales (impuestos, burocracia)", and experts rate the government's cutting of red tape and taxes at 3.7–3.8 out of 10 — [GEM España 2025-26](https://observatoriodelemprendimiento.es/gem-spain/).
scale: about 9,200 registered startup founders in 2023 ([ClosingGap via Autónomos y Emprendedor](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/emprendedores/negocios-dirigidos-solo-mujeres-reciben-apenas-3-total-financiacion-disponible/20240927183406038686.html)), plus all new SL founders who control their company.
cost_impact: the monthly autónomo quota and gestoría fees. Amounts were not verified here; they are covered by the labour and tax researchers.
driver_status: the Social Security rules for controlling shareholders (autónomo societario) and the VAT law (Ley 37/1992). **In force.** Spain's non-use of the EU small-business VAT exemption (Directive 2020/285) is AES's claim and was **not verified**.
solved_today: gestorías; accounting SaaS such as Holded (€15–€199 a month excluding VAT, [Holded](https://www.holded.com/es/precios)); the Ley 28/2022 rebate for founders who are also employed.
software_solvable: Partly. Automated bookkeeping and quarterly filings cut gestoría time. The quota and VAT burden are policy.
confidence: Medium. The voice is strong but comes from advocacy; overlaps with tax and labour.

title: Notary and commercial-registry formalities for incorporation and every capital increase
who: every SL startup, especially those raising several rounds or convertible notes.
where: national.
scale: 376 rounds in 2025 ([Bankinter](https://www.fundacionbankinter.org/noticias/startups-2025-observatorio/)); inference: each one needs company-law formalities. Every new SL goes through incorporation.
cost_impact: notary and registry fees for capital increases and legal fees per round were **not quantified** (gap).
driver_status: company law (Ley de Sociedades de Capital), Ley 28/2022 and the €1 minimum capital shown on ONE. **In force.**
solved_today: startup lawyers, notaries, packaged incorporations (Qonto/Finutive) and gestorías.
software_solvable: Partly. Round-closing workflows, generation of resolutions and deeds, the cap table and a digital share register can be automated. Notarisation remains.
confidence: Medium. The process is verified; costs and delays per round are not.

title: Onboarding foreign investors and co-founders (tax numbers, apostilles, representatives)
who: startups raising from non-resident angels or funds, or with foreign co-founders, from seed to growth.
where: national (tax agency AEAT and consulates).
reality: each foreign investor needs a Spanish tax number (NIF) before the deed. Since Ley 28/2022, a foreigner number (NIE) is no longer needed. Investing companies apply with Form 036, apostilled registry certificates and powers of attorney. An investing company cannot get a NIF if its own representatives lack Spanish NIFs.
evidence:
- NIF without NIE; AEAT has 10 business days; the NIF can be revoked if the investment is not documented within 6 months — [BOE art. 9](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2022-21739).
- Consular route; Forms 030/036; apostille or legalisation plus translation; a NIF "cannot be assigned to the legal entity if the legal representatives" lack a Spanish NIF; 10 days for companies — [ONE](https://one.gob.es/en/procedures/application-tax-identification-number-nif-international-investors).
- Mixed local and international rounds carry 55% of H1 2026 capital; domestic-only rounds 10% — [Bankinter H1 2026](https://www.fundacionbankinter.org/informe-observatorio/h1-2026-informe-de-inversion-en-startups/).
scale: inference from Bankinter: about 90% of H1 2026 capital involved non-domestic investors.
cost_impact: delays to closings were not quantified (gap).
driver_status: Ley 28/2022 art. 9, **in force**. Foreign-investment screening (RD 571/2023) was **not verified**.
solved_today: lawyers, notaries and gestorías, plus the investor's own counsel.
software_solvable: Partly. Checklists for identity checks, tax numbers and powers of attorney, and closing trackers shared with investors and the notary.

title: Non-EU founders need an ENISA favourable report plus UGE approval to reside, and the golden visa is gone
who: non-EU founders relocating to start or grow a company (pre-seed to seed). Common in Barcelona and Madrid; also in Valencia and Málaga (inference).
where: national (ENISA, the UGE immigration office and consulates).
reality: the founder must get ENISA's favourable report on the business plan, then UGE authorisation and a consular visa. A foreigner number (NIE) and a residence and work permit are needed before using CIRCE. Holding the startup certificate does not guarantee the visa.
scale: inference: about 550 Catalan startups with a foreign founder (28% of the 1,978 with nationality data). National numbers were not found.
cost_impact: weeks to months of process. Lawyer fees were not found.
driver_status: Ley 14/2013 as amended by Ley 28/2022, **in force**. The golden visa was **repealed in April 2025** (per Economía 3).
solved_today: immigration lawyers, gestorías (Economía 3 cites Managora) and ENISA's guide.
software_solvable: Partly. Dossier builders and status tracking help; decisions stay administrative.

title: Remote hires and digital-nomad permits: higher income thresholds, a stricter UGE, Social Security certificates and residence-card queues
who: startups hiring non-EU remote staff or relocating staff, foreign startups employing people in Spain, and founders on nomad permits.
where: national. Delays for residence-card (TIE) appointments are reported in Madrid, Barcelona and Valencia.
reality: applicants must show at least €2,849 a month (2026), with apostilled and sworn-translated documents and a valid Social Security coverage certificate. The UGE now rejects outright more often instead of asking for documents. A foreign employer without a valid certificate may have to register and pay Spanish Social Security. After approval, TIE appointments are hard to get.
scale: no official count of permits (gap).
cost_impact: refusals and document requests add weeks. Using an employer of record costs $599 per employee per month ([Deel](https://www.deel.com/pricing); [Remote](https://remote.com/pricing)).
driver_status: Ley 14/2013 (as amended by Ley 28/2022), **in force**. The 2026 minimum wage comes from RD 126/2026 (as reported by Anchorless). The stricter practice is administrative and reported, not a rule change.
solved_today: immigration lawyers, relocation services and employer-of-record providers.
software_solvable: Partly. Pre-checks of eligibility and documents, guidance on Social Security certificates, and appointment and renewal tracking.

title: Beckham regime for founders and key hires: eligibility tied to startup criteria and a six-month election window
who: founders relocating to Spain and highly qualified hires of startups.
where: national state income tax. The provincial (foral) regimes in Bizkaia (Bilbao), Gipuzkoa, Álava and Navarra were not checked.
reality: founders must qualify either through an "actividad emprendedora" backed by ENISA, or as highly qualified professionals earning more than 40% of their income from startups. They must file Modelo 149 within 6 months of registering with Social Security. The immigration permit does not give them the tax regime.
scale: not found.
cost_impact: inference from the BOE rates: missing the window means paying progressive rates up to 47% instead of a flat 24% on income up to €600k.
driver_status: art. 93 LIRPF as amended by Ley 28/2022, **in force**. No 2025–26 amendment was found, but this was not exhaustively verified.
solved_today: tax advisers.
software_solvable: Partly. An eligibility and deadline tracker linked to the immigration and Social Security dates.

title: Tech-talent cost, AI and data pay premiums, and competition from remote and foreign employers
who: seed to Series B startups hiring engineers and data or AI staff, mainly in Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia and Málaga.
where: national; Catalan data available.
reality: startups compete for senior engineers with foreign companies hiring remotely. About 70% of candidates want fully remote work, AI and data roles command the top pay bands, and on-site roles cost more. Founders use equity to close the gap, which brings in the problems of STA-02.
scale: 30,537 employees in Catalan startups alone.
cost_impact: the pay bands above; at least 20% extra for on-site roles; CTO equity of 0.3–3%.
driver_status: a market force (remote demand, AI boom). No regulatory driver.
software_solvable: Partly. Pay benchmarking, equity-pay tools and remote-employment compliance help; the talent supply is structural.

title: Selling to the public sector: single-bidder contracts, solvency and experience barriers, complex innovation procurement
who: startups selling to government (GovTech, cybersecurity, AI and data), from seed to Series B.
where: national central government (Administración General del Estado). Regional and local procurement was not measured.
reality: tenders often have a single bidder and are won by large integrators. Requirements for financial solvency and prior experience shut out young firms. Innovation procurement (compra pública innovadora) is "muy complicada" (very complicated), and some contracts are declared secret.
scale: all central-government procurement. The startup share was not measured.
cost_impact: startups are shut out of a large buyer. Bid costs were not quantified.
driver_status: the public-contracts law (Ley 9/2017, LCSP), **in force**. AES asks for reform; no bill found. Overlaps with the procurement researcher.
solved_today: subcontracting through integrators and consortia (inference); tender alert services (not verified).
software_solvable: Partly. Tender discovery, matching with consortium partners and packs of solvency documents. The structural barriers need legal reform.
confidence: Medium. The data comes from an advocacy group; the official dataset was not identified.

title: A small domestic market forces early internationalisation, and corporate demand looks weak
who: B2B SaaS and deeptech startups from seed to Series A.
where: national. Data for Catalonia, Andalusia and the Basque Country.
reality: startups must sell abroad early, which means handling foreign currency invoicing, foreign VAT and contracts. Meanwhile experts rate the domestic market's dynamism poorly.
evidence:
- 61% of Catalan startups export. Of those with foreign clients, 37% export more than half of turnover and 15% more than 90%. Top markets are the US, Germany, France, Italy and the UK — [ACCIÓ, Feb 2026](https://www.accio.gencat.cat/web/.content/bancconeixement/documents/pindoles/ACCIO-analisi-ecosistema-startup-catalunya-2026-pindola-en.pdf).
- 73.8% of recent entrepreneurs in Andalusia do not export — [GEM Andalucía, 29 Sep 2026](https://observatoriodelemprendimiento.es/presentado-el-informe-gem-andalucia-2025-26/).
- 33.6% of Basque new ventures sell abroad, a record — [GEM CAPV, 9 Oct 2026](https://observatoriodelemprendimiento.es/presentado-informe-gem-pais-vasco-2025-26/).
- Experts rate "Mercado interno dinámico" (a dynamic domestic market) 3.9–4.6 out of 10 — [GEM España 2025-26](https://observatoriodelemprendimiento.es/gem-spain/).
- Corporate investors take part in about 1 in 5 rounds — [Dealroom/SpainCap, June 2025](https://www.spaincap.org/storage/documents/2025/06/the-spanish-tech-ecosystem.pdf).
scale: inference: about 1,465 exporting Catalan startups (61% of 2,403).
cost_impact: not quantified.
driver_status: a market force.
solved_today: ICEX programmes, COFIDES (cited by [Tetuan Valley](https://tetuanvalley.com/blog-financiacion-publica-para-startups/)), employers of record and payroll across several countries.
software_solvable: Partly. Cross-border invoicing and tax, and localisation tools.
confidence: Low-medium. No data on how long corporate sales take.

title: AI Act and AI-governance compliance for AI startups
who: AI-native startups (18.4% of startups founded since 2021) and startups that use AI (29.7% of Catalan startups work with AI and big data), from seed to Series B.
where: EU-wide. Spain's supervisor is AESIA, based in A Coruña.
reality: teams must classify their systems and meet the transparency rules of Art. 50, which apply from 2 Aug 2026 (2 Dec 2026 for generative systems already on the market). They must also prepare for high-risk obligations whose dates have moved, while the national rules remain unclear.
evidence:
- AI startups are 18.4% of those founded since 2021 — [Dealroom, 12 May 2026](https://dealroom.co/reports/the-spanish-tech-ecosystem-report-2026/).
- 713 Catalan startups (29.7%) work with AI and big data — [ACCIÓ](https://www.accio.gencat.cat/web/.content/bancconeixement/documents/pindoles/ACCIO-analisi-ecosistema-startup-catalunya-2026-pindola-en.pdf).
- 79.8% of Basque new ventures see AI as important — [GEM CAPV](https://observatoriodelemprendimiento.es/presentado-informe-gem-pais-vasco-2025-26/). 27% of Valencian ones include AI in their strategy — [GEM CV](https://observatoriodelemprendimiento.es/presentado-informe-gem-de-la-comunidad-valenciana/).
- Current timeline — [AI Act Explorer timeline](https://artificialintelligenceact.eu/implementation-timeline/) (updated 31 Aug 2026):
- Art. 50 applies from 2 Aug 2026;
- generative systems already on the market have until 2 Dec 2026;
- Annex III high-risk obligations apply from **2 Dec 2027**;
- Annex I high-risk obligations apply from **2 Aug 2028**.
- The original law applied most rules after 24 months and some high-risk duties after 36 months from 1 Aug 2024 — [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_Intelligence_Act). By my arithmetic that meant Aug 2026 and Aug 2027, so the timeline above reflects a postponement.
- AESIA is advising Poland and Lithuania on applying the Regulation ([30 Sep 2026](https://aesia.digital.gob.es/es/actualidad/20260930-aesia-recibe-en-a-coruna-a-delegaciones-de-polonia-y-lituania)) and meeting business groups ([20 Oct 2026](https://aesia.digital.gob.es/es/actualidad/20261020-la-aesia-con-las-empresas-para-convertir-la-ia-en-un-motor-de-competitividad-e-innovacion-responsable)).
- Mateo: "Regular en exceso hace que nuestras startups no puedan competir en igualdad de condiciones" (over-regulating means our startups can't compete on equal terms) — [El Diario de Madrid, 9 Dec 2025](https://www.eldiariodemadrid.es/articulo/entrevistas/carlos-mateo-asociacion-startups-emprendimiento-innovacion-espana/20251209125147115994.html).
scale: more than 250 Spanish AI startups ([Dealroom 2025](https://www.spaincap.org/storage/documents/2025/06/the-spanish-tech-ecosystem.pdf)); 713 in Catalonia work with AI ([ACCIÓ](https://www.accio.gencat.cat/web/.content/bancconeixement/documents/pindoles/ACCIO-analisi-ecosistema-startup-catalunya-2026-pindola-en.pdf)).
cost_impact: not quantified.
solved_today: law firms and consultancies (prices not found); compliance SaaS (not verified).
software_solvable: Yes. AI inventories, risk classification, technical documentation and content labelling are naturally software.
confidence: Medium. The deadline status is only partly verified.

title: Anti-piracy IP blocking by internet providers takes legitimate startup sites and shops offline
who: startups hosted on shared content-delivery networks such as Cloudflare: SaaS, e-commerce and media, at any stage.
where: national (Movistar, O2, MásOrange, Vodafone, Digi and smaller providers). The court orders come from commercial courts in Barcelona.
reality: during live sports broadcasts, internet providers block IP ranges that pirate streams share with legitimate sites. Company websites become unreachable and online shops stop selling at peak hours. Startups lack the evidence they would need to claim compensation.
scale: no count of affected sites (gap).
cost_impact: lost sales and downtime during broadcasts, not quantified.
driver_status: court-ordered blocking, **in force and ongoing** as of Apr–Aug 2026. No appeals reported.
solved_today: changing IPs or CDN settings, and complaints. No tools were verified.
software_solvable: Partly. Detecting blocks from Spanish internet providers, automatic evidence logs for claims, and failover across several CDNs.

title: Capital and support scarcity outside Madrid and Barcelona
who: pre-seed to Series A startups in Málaga, Sevilla, Zaragoza, the Canary Islands, Bilbao and, to a lesser extent, Valencia.
where: Málaga, Sevilla (Andalusia), Zaragoza and Teruel (Aragón), the Canary Islands, Bilbao and San Sebastián (Basque Country), and Valencia.
reality: founders rely on savings, family and investors from elsewhere in Spain or abroad. Local VC is thin. When an accelerator leaves a city, as Demium left Málaga, the local flow of pre-seed deals drops.
evidence:
- Madrid and Barcelona take more than two thirds of VC — [Dealroom, 12 May 2026](https://dealroom.co/reports/the-spanish-tech-ecosystem-report-2026/).
- Málaga: under €8M invested in 2023; Demium left in Feb 2023; the lack of VC is "una característica definitoria" (a defining feature) — [Málaga Hub, 3 Jan 2024](https://malagahub.substack.com/p/las-mayores-rondas-de-inversion-del). Seed and Series A struggles — [KEA](https://keaadvisory.eu/publications/the-rise-of-the-malaga-startup-ecosystem-opportunities-challenges-and-financial-strategy-in-andalusia/).
- Andalusia: financing is the worst-rated condition — [GEM Andalucía](https://observatoriodelemprendimiento.es/presentado-el-informe-gem-andalucia-2025-26/).
- Basque Country: use of bank financing fell from 43.6% to 26%; savings rose to 93.6%; family and friends to 41.9% — [GEM CAPV](https://observatoriodelemprendimiento.es/presentado-informe-gem-pais-vasco-2025-26/).
- Certified startups: Zamora 1, Teruel 2 — [El Diario de Madrid](https://www.eldiariodemadrid.es/articulo/emprendedores/enisa-2000-startups-certificadas-madrid-barcelona-ecosistema-emprendedor/20260220112754121816.html).
- The Canary Islands have one of the lowest shares of recent entrepreneurs — [GEM España 2025-26](https://observatoriodelemprendimiento.es/gem-spain/).
scale: I found no counts for these hubs (see Section 2 gaps).
cost_impact: smaller rounds. Inference: startups may move to Madrid or Barcelona; no data found.
driver_status: a market force (geographic concentration of capital).
solved_today: ENISA nationwide; regional bodies such as ICF, IVACE, SPRI, SODERCAN and IDEPA ([Tetuan Valley](https://tetuanvalley.com/blog-financiacion-publica-para-startups/)); city-council calls that score the ENISA certificate.
software_solvable: No for the capital itself. Partly through syndication and investor-matching platforms.

title: Few exits, so founders, angels and employees with stock options stay illiquid
who: founders, business angels (who must hold for 3–12 years to keep their deduction) and employees with stock options.
where: national.
reality: exits are few and are mostly M&A with undisclosed prices. Angels and employees hold illiquid stakes for years, and secondary sales are rare (inference).
evidence:
- H1 2026: 19 exits (−32%), none with a disclosed value. Historically 70% of exits disclose no value and M&A is more than 90% of exits — [Bankinter H1 2026](https://www.fundacionbankinter.org/informe-observatorio/h1-2026-informe-de-inversion-en-startups/).
- 2025: 49 exits, flat; the Hotelbeds listing at a €2,840M valuation; vLex sold for €850M; Wallapop sold to Naver for €377M — [Bankinter, 22 Jan 2026](https://www.fundacionbankinter.org/noticias/startups-2025-observatorio/).
- "No new unicorn since 2023" — [Dealroom/SpainCap, June 2025](https://www.spaincap.org/storage/documents/2025/06/the-spanish-tech-ecosystem.pdf).
- 215 exits in Catalonia over 2016–2025 — [ACCIÓ](https://www.accio.gencat.cat/web/.content/bancconeixement/documents/pindoles/ACCIO-analisi-ecosistema-startup-catalunya-2026-pindola-en.pdf).
scale: national.
cost_impact: inference: the 10-year stock-option deferral clock (STA-02) and the angels' holding windows keep running while there is little liquidity.
driver_status: a market force. Proposals to support startup listings are **not enacted**.
solved_today: M&A advisers. Secondary-sale platforms were not verified.
software_solvable: Mostly no. Partly through secondary-sale and valuation tooling.

title: Missing finance function: reporting, cash forecasting and board packs
who: seed to Series A startups without a CFO, typically 5–50 staff.
where: national.
reality: founders rebuild their numbers again and again for investors, ENISA and CDTI applications, and the board. Cash forecasts are unreliable. ENISA asks for filed annual accounts, and audited ones for loans above €300k.
evidence:
- Fractional-CFO tiers of €750, €1,250 and €2,000 a month. Warning signs listed include "no hay una previsión de caja fiable" (there is no reliable cash forecast) and founders spending too much time rebuilding numbers — [Premoney, 11 Sep 2026](https://www.premoney.es/blog/cfo-externo) (vendor source).
- Audited accounts above €300k — [Premoney](https://www.premoney.es/blog/requisitos-solicitar-enisa).
- Startups underinvest in financial models and cash forecasts — [KEA](https://keaadvisory.eu/publications/the-rise-of-the-malaga-startup-ecosystem-opportunities-challenges-and-financial-strategy-in-andalusia/) (unsourced opinion).
- The Startup CFO course announced on 13 Oct 2026 (title only) — [The Startup Oasis archive](https://startupsoasis.substack.com/archive).
scale: not quantified. Inference: most seed-stage startups.
cost_impact: €9k–€24k a year for a fractional CFO (derived from Premoney's tiers).
driver_status: requirements from investors and public funders. No regulatory change.
solved_today: fractional CFOs, accounting SaaS (Holded) and spreadsheets.
software_solvable: Yes. Financial planning, cash forecasting and board or investor reporting connected to the accounting system.

title: Paperwork behind the angel tax deduction (company certificates, holding windows, misinformation)
who: pre-seed and seed startups raising from Spanish business angels, and the angels themselves.
where: national state income tax. Regional top-up deductions and the provincial (foral) regimes were not checked.
reality: for each angel, the company must issue a certificate confirming the requirements are met. The shares must be bought at incorporation or in a capital increase within 5 years (7 for certified startups) and held for more than 3 and less than 12 years. Contradictory information circulates online, for example a €250k limit instead of €100k.
evidence:
- 50% deduction, €100k base, the holding window, and "certificación expedida por la entidad" (a certificate issued by the company) — [BOE](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2022-21739).
- The rate rose from 30% to 50% on a €100k base — [Computerworld, 23 Dec 2025](https://www.computerworld.es/article/4111037/carlos-mateo-la-inmensa-mayoria-de-startups-que-hay-en-espana-son-tecnologicas.html).
- A €250k claim, contradicted by the BOE — [Venza, 16 Jun 2025](https://venza.legal/ley-startups-2025-fiscalidad-inversion/).
scale: not quantified. Inference: most early rounds with local angels.
cost_impact: administrative work, plus a risk that the tax agency withdraws the benefit if requirements lapse (Venza).
driver_status: Ley 28/2022 final provision 3 (art. 68.1 LIRPF), **in force** since 1 Jan 2023.
solved_today: lawyers and gestorías draft the certificates (no price data).
software_solvable: Yes or partly. Certificates and investor tax packs generated from the cap table, with tracking of the holding windows.
confidence: Medium-low. The pain is inferred from the legal requirement; I found no complaint data.

title: University spin-offs struggle with technology transfer
who: spin-offs from universities and research centres (deeptech, biotech) at pre-seed to seed.
where: national; strongest base in Barcelona (Catalonia has 308 spin-offs and Barcelona is the 2nd EU spin-off hub).
reality: research results do not reach the market quickly, and experts rate R&D transfer poorly.
evidence:
- Mateo: "Falta que esa investigación salga del cajón y llegue al mercado" (research still needs to get out of the drawer and reach the market) — [El Diario de Madrid, 9 Dec 2025](https://www.eldiariodemadrid.es/articulo/entrevistas/carlos-mateo-asociacion-startups-emprendimiento-innovacion-espana/20251209125147115994.html).
- ENISA's José Bayón: "fallamos en la transferencia" (we fail at transfer) — [Innovaspain, 10 Mar 2023](https://www.innovaspain.com/ley-de-startups-emprendedores-enisa-carlos-mateo-jose-bayon-pons-ip-samaipata/).
- Experts rate R&D transfer 3.7–4.2 out of 10 — [GEM España 2025-26](https://observatoriodelemprendimiento.es/gem-spain/).
- 308 spin-offs in Catalonia — [ACCIÓ](https://www.accio.gencat.cat/web/.content/bancconeixement/documents/pindoles/ACCIO-analisi-ecosistema-startup-catalunya-2026-pindola-en.pdf).
scale: 308 spin-offs in Catalonia; national count not found.
cost_impact: not quantified.
driver_status: university technology-transfer offices (OTRI) and university and science laws. Not verified in this session.
solved_today: university technology-transfer offices and accelerators.
software_solvable: Partly. Managing licences and agreements, and spin-off cap tables that include the university's stake.

title: Funding gap for women-led startups
who: all-female founding teams at every stage.
where: national. 60% of women-founded startups are in Madrid and Catalonia; the Basque Country (18.8%) and Galicia (17.9%) have the highest shares of female founders.
reality: women-led startups raise far less, and women applying for start-up loans are 10–20% less likely to get them.
scale: about 1,500 women founders (2023).
cost_impact: less capital per startup.
driver_status: a market and cultural force. ENISA runs a dedicated "Emprendedoras Digitales" line ([Tetuan Valley](https://tetuanvalley.com/blog-financiacion-publica-para-startups/)).
solved_today: dedicated credit lines and awards such as the Women Startup Awards.
software_solvable: No. It is a matter of who allocates capital.

title: VeriFactu forces adaptation or replacement of invoicing software, TPVs, cash registers and scales
who: All sectors that invoice with software. Autónomos, micro (<10), small (10–49) and medium (50–249) firms, and startups. Hardest hit: retail with weighing scales (fruterías, carnicerías), bars and restaurants with TPVs, personal services. Excluded: SII users (generally larger firms; SII thresholds not verified here) and Basque foral taxpayers.
where: National (territorio común): Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, Sevilla, Zaragoza, Málaga, Palma, Murcia, Alicante, Valladolid, Vigo, A Coruña. It very likely also applies in Las Palmas and Santa Cruz, since IRPF and IS are state taxes in Canarias (inference, not verified). Not in Bilbao, Vitoria or Donostia (TicketBAI). Navarra is unverified.
reality: Owners must find out whether their invoicing program, TPV or scale counts as a "SIF". They then need the vendor's adapted version (hash chaining, QR, event log, or VERI*FACTU submission), and in POS settings often new hardware. Tickets count as simplified invoices, so the shop till is in scope.
evidence:
- The legal compliance dates are 1 Jan 2027 (IS) and 1 Jul 2027 (rest). — [BOE consolidated RD 1007/2023, update 03/12/2025](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2023-24840); [AEAT FAQ, 21 Oct 2026](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/iva/sistemas-informaticos-facturacion-verifactu/preguntas-frecuentes.html)
- Digital scales in fruterías can cost more than €2,500 to adapt; bar and restaurant cash registers up to €1,800 (ATA, single-source). — [AyE, 17 Sep 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/info-ata/autonomos-tendrian-que-adaptarse-verifactu-meses-ata-pide-que-sea-vez-que-factura-electronica/20260916172435055901.html)
- Integrated TPV, cash register and ordering systems need more than a software update. — [AyE, 6 Oct 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/hacienda-cede-autonomos-tendran-ano-mas-adaptar-programas-facturacion-verifactu/20261005152934056163.html)
- Módulos users, VAT-exempt professionals, property-renting companies and TPV tickets are all in scope. — [AyE, 24 Aug 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/miles-autonomos-deberan-cambiar-programas-facturacion-estan-uno-cuatro-supuestos/20260821125529055525.html)
- Readiness ranges from 35.4% prepared (ENA, Oct 2025) to 7% fully compliant (Xolo, Jan 2026). — [ENA 2025](https://www.infoautonomos.com/club-cursos/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/11/ESTUDIO-NACIONAL-DEL-AUTONOMO-INFOAUTONOMOS-ENA-2025.pdf); [AyE, 23 Jan 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/autonomos/ocho-cada-diez-autonomos-aun-han-adaptado-verifactu-solo-7-cumple-plenamente-ley/20260122144822051340.html)
scale: About 2.5M autónomos and 2.1M companies (single-source estimate). — [AyE, 4 Mar 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/tributos-aclara-riesgos-autonomos-que-aun-facturen-excel-word-cuando-llegue-verifactu/20260303123152052310.html). The RETA has 3.41M members. — [AyE, 3 Mar 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/info-ata/febrero-sumo-281-nuevos-autonomos-cada-dia-reta-supera-34-millones-afiliados/20260303142150052315.html)
cost_impact:
- Software €0–€30/month (Section 6).
- POS hardware €1,800–€2,500+ per device type (ATA).
- "Miles de euros" already spent by some businesses (ATA).
- Theoretical exposure of up to €50,000 per year for using non-compliant systems. — [GPA Asociados](https://gpasoc.com/aplazamiento-verifactu-2028-plazos-vigentes/); [Webpsilon](https://www.webpsilon.com/blog/verifactu-que-es-cuando-entra-en-vigor-y-a-quien-afecta/)
driver_status:
- Legal basis: Ley 11/2021 (anti-fraud; LGT arts. 29.2.j and 201 bis); RD 1007/2023 as amended by RD 254/2025 and RDL 15/2025; Orden HAC/1177/2024.
- In force, with compliance dates of 1 Jan 2027 and 1 Jul 2027.
- **Postponement to October 2028 announced** by Hacienda on 5 Oct 2026 but **not yet in the BOE** (status at 21 Oct 2026).
- Producers have been obliged since 29 Jul 2025.
solved_today:
- Vendor upgrades: TS Facturas €6.6–€28/month; Anfix €4.99–€99.99; Quipu €17–€59 list; Contasimple free to €19.95; Declarando VeriFactu Plus €9.90; Cuéntica €9–€29.
- Free options: FacturaScripts, the AEAT free app.
- POS vendors and gestorías.
- Complaints: VeriFactu error 4124 blocking Holded invoicing (Mar 2026); "La implementación de nuevas obligaciones fiscales te las hace pagar". — [Trustpilot Holded 1-star](https://es.trustpilot.com/review/holded.com?stars=1)
software_solvable: Yes for software. Partly for POS and scale fleets, where hardware replacement and on-site integration dominate.

title: Regulatory whiplash and "compliance limbo" around VeriFactu dates
who: All of the above, plus software vendors and asesorías that must plan releases and advise clients.
where: National.
reality: Firms that adapted in late 2025 have sunk costs. Others are waiting. Vendors and asesorías must tell clients that 2027 is still the law while 2028 is the announced reality, and the QR obligation is also in limbo. ATA: "otra vez la incertidumbre como norma".
evidence:
- DF 4ª was modified by RD 254/2025 and RDL 15/2025. — [BOE consolidated](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2023-24840)
- The 5 Oct 2026 note announces October 2028. — [Hacienda note](https://www.hacienda.gob.es/sgt/gabsehacienda/nota-informativa-verifactu.pdf)
- It is not in the BOE. — [AyE, 16 Oct 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/hacienda-vuelve-generar-caos-entre-autonomos-porque-sigue-aprobar-aplazamiento-verifactu-boe/20261016235738056377.html); [AyE, 20 Oct 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/hacienda-confirma-que-tambien-aplazara-obligacion-autonomos-incluir-qr-todas-facturas/20261020174935056434.html)
- Four in ten SMEs felt relief at the previous delay. — [MuyPymes, 20 Oct 2026](https://www.muypymes.com/2026/10/20/pymes-autonomos-confunde-verifactu-factura-electronica)
- Secondary sources disagree on whether >€8M firms keep an October 2027 VeriFactu date. — [Infoautónomos, 15 Oct 2026](https://www.infoautonomos.com/blog/retraso-verifactu/) vs [Hacienda note](https://www.hacienda.gob.es/sgt/gabsehacienda/nota-informativa-verifactu.pdf)
scale: Same as TAX-01, about 4.6M taxpayers (single-source estimate).
cost_impact: Sunk adaptation spend; repeated advisory communications; planning paralysis. No € figure available.
driver_status: An RDL or RD amending DF 4ª of RD 1007/2023 is **pending**. A later "convergence" amendment covering ViDA is announced but not drafted. Note that Congress failed to convalidate RDL 16/2025, RDL 2/2026 and RDL 26/2026 in 2026 (Section 4 and Section 7), so convalidation risk is real.
solved_today: Vendor blogs and emails, asesoría circulars, trade-association guidance (ATA, AEDAF). None of it is systematic.
software_solvable: Partly. A regulatory-status monitor and compliance calendar (feeding vendors, asesorías and SMEs) is software. The uncertainty itself is political.

title: Excel/Word/manual invoicing in a legal grey zone and forced migration
who: Autónomos and micro firms (professionals, trades, freelancers), and asesorías that issue invoices for clients.
where: National (territorio común).
reality: Many still produce invoices from Word or Excel templates. The DGT says this is "no automáticamente excluido": if Excel calculates, stores or generates invoices it is treated as a SIF. Handwritten paper invoices are outside the rule. Migrating means moving client lists, numbering series and history into a compliant tool.
evidence:
- DGT V2045-25. — [AyE, 4 Mar 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/tributos-aclara-riesgos-autonomos-que-aun-facturen-excel-word-cuando-llegue-verifactu/20260303123152052310.html)
- DGT V0817-26 (asesorías issuing invoices for clients are in scope). — [AyE, 7 Sep 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/hacienda-exime-asesorias-que-llevan-contabilidad-autonomos-adaptar-software-verifactu/20260905221011055741.html)
- 50% of autónomos use invoicing software. — [ENA 2025](https://www.infoautonomos.com/club-cursos/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/11/ESTUDIO-NACIONAL-DEL-AUTONOMO-INFOAUTONOMOS-ENA-2025.pdf)
- 63% have medium or high Excel dependence. — [RRHHDigital, 9 Oct 2026](https://www.rrhhdigital.com/secciones/pymes/803404/el-41-de-pymes-y-autonomos-confunde-verifactu-con-la-factura-electronica/)
- 95% of small asesorías and pymes use Excel as their main tool. — [ElDerecho, 19 Nov 2025](https://elderecho.com/el-65-de-las-pymes-no-esta-preparada-para-la-entrada-en-vigor-de-verifactu)
- 6 in 10 asesorías invoice with Excel, and 83% of autónomos do not use digital tools to issue invoices. — [Merca2, 20 Jul 2025](https://www.merca2.es/2025/07/20/verifactu-asesorias-excel-2215495/)
- The figures conflict because samples differ.
scale: About half of 3.41M RETA members do not use invoicing software (inference from ENA).
cost_impact: Migration time. Exposure under art. 201 bis if Excel is deemed a non-compliant SIF.
driver_status: RD 1007/2023 and DGT criteria. Same dates as TAX-01, with a pending postponement.
solved_today: Free tiers (Contasimple Básico, 12 documents/year; FacturaScripts; the AEAT app), €5–€10/month entry plans (Anfix, TS Facturas, Declarando VeriFactu Plus), and gestorías.
software_solvable: Yes. Template-to-compliant importers, numbering continuity, and historic archive conversion.
confidence: Medium. The pain is real, but how many businesses are affected is uncertain.

title: Information gap and fear of fines (VeriFactu vs e-invoicing confusion)
who: Pymes and autónomos in all sectors, especially traditional ones.
where: National.
reality: Owners do not know which obligation applies when, whether their tool is compliant, or which "mode" to pick. They rely on asesorías that are themselves catching up, and many postpone decisions.
evidence:
- 41% confuse VeriFactu with e-invoicing; 9% clearly understand; 30% have no plan; about half fear fines (TeamSystem/Ipsos, 1,200 interviews). — [MuyPymes, 20 Oct 2026](https://www.muypymes.com/2026/10/20/pymes-autonomos-confunde-verifactu-factura-electronica); [RRHHDigital, 9 Oct 2026](https://www.rrhhdigital.com/secciones/pymes/803404/el-41-de-pymes-y-autonomos-confunde-verifactu-con-la-factura-electronica/)
- 87% cite lack of regulatory knowledge as the main barrier; 70% had never heard of the obligation (2025). — [Merca2, 20 Jul 2025](https://www.merca2.es/2025/07/20/verifactu-asesorias-excel-2215495/)
- 72% of asesorías say clients underestimate the change. — [ElDerecho, 19 Nov 2025](https://elderecho.com/el-65-de-las-pymes-no-esta-preparada-para-la-entrada-en-vigor-de-verifactu)
- The main brake is "el temor a cometer errores técnicos". — [AyE, 23 Jan 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/autonomos/ocho-cada-diez-autonomos-aun-han-adaptado-verifactu-solo-7-cumple-plenamente-ley/20260122144822051340.html)
- The surveys are vendor-run; the TeamSystem and Quipu figures are not independent.
scale: Millions; 41% of SMEs confused (survey).
cost_impact: Delayed adoption and reliance on paid advice. Not quantified in €.
driver_status: Overlapping VeriFactu, B2B e-invoicing, TicketBAI and SII rules, with shifting dates.
solved_today: Asesoría circulars, vendor content marketing, regional training (for example a free Extremadura e-invoicing course; headline only, not read). — [AyE autonomos section listing, 10 Oct 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/autonomos/)
software_solvable: Partly. Guided compliance checkers and "which rules apply to me" engines help, but this is largely an advice problem.
confidence: High that the gap exists; medium on its size.

title: Mandatory B2B e-invoicing (structured formats, platforms, UBL copy to the AEAT)
who: Every business and professional invoicing other businesses in Spain. Firms above €8M turnover go first; then SMEs, autónomos and startups. B2C sellers are mostly unaffected.
where: National. The UBL mapping accepts TicketBAI QR references, which implies Basque firms are covered (inference).
reality: From Oct 2027 for large firms and Oct 2028 for everyone else, an emailed PDF stops being a valid B2B invoice. Firms must issue and receive structured e-invoices via a private platform or the free SPFE. Anyone not using the SPFE must send it a UBL copy at the moment of issue. Large customers will demand e-invoices from suppliers from 2027.
evidence:
- RD 238/2026 (BOE 31 Mar 2026). — [AEAT, 31 Mar 2026](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/todas-noticias/2026/marzo/31/facturacion-electronica-obligatoria.html)
- Orden HAC/1028/2026 (BOE 5 Oct 2026, in force 6 Oct 2026). — [BOE PDF](https://www.boe.es/boe/dias/2026/10/05/pdfs/BOE-A-2026-20587.pdf)
- Dates 6 Oct 2027, 6 Oct 2028 and 6 Oct 2029. — [AEAT, 7 Oct 2026](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/todas-noticias/2026/octubre/7/solucion-publica-facturacion-electronica.html)
- PDF accompaniment for 12 months for >€8M issuers. — [AyE, 8 Oct 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/hacienda-confirma-que-autonomos-tendran-que-usar-factura-electronica-obligatoria-proximos-meses/20261007212015056227.html)
- Four formats; sanctions up to €10,000 (single-source). — [B2Brouter, 18 Jun 2026](https://www.b2brouter.net/es/plazos-obligatoriedad-factura-electronica-b2b/)
scale: All B2B invoicers; no official count found. Baseline: 557M B2B e-invoices already exchanged in 2024 (+21%). — [ElDerecho, 19 Nov 2025](https://elderecho.com/el-65-de-las-pymes-no-esta-preparada-para-la-entrada-en-vigor-de-verifactu)
cost_impact: The SPFE is free. Commercial networks charge €0–€300/year (B2Brouter Basic €0 for 24 transactions/year, Professional €110, Business €300 + IVA). — [B2Brouter precios](https://www.b2brouter.net/es/precios/). Integration with ERP and POS is not quantified. ATA fears a second investment round after VeriFactu.
driver_status:
- Legal basis: Ley 18/2022 art. 12 (art. 2 bis Ley 56/2007), Ley 7/2024 (DA 21ª Ley 56/2007), RD 238/2026 (in force 20 Apr 2026), Orden HAC/1028/2026 (in force 6 Oct 2026).
- Status: **upcoming deadlines** of 6 Oct 2027 (>€8M), 6 Oct 2028 (rest) and 6 Oct 2029 (status reporting for personas físicas).
solved_today: B2G experience via FACe and Facturae; invoicing SaaS with Facturae and UBL output (TS Facturas, Contasimple Profesional with FACe, Anfix); networks such as B2Brouter and Peppol; the coming free SPFE.
software_solvable: Yes.
confidence: High on the rules; low on cost estimates.

title: Invoice-status and payment-date reporting (rejection, due date, full payment)
who: Invoice recipients, which in practice means every business with suppliers. >€8M firms from Oct 2027; companies ≤€8M from Oct 2028; autónomos (personas físicas) from Oct 2029 (voluntary before then).
where: National.
reality: Accounts payable (often the owner or the gestoría) must tell the SPFE or the counterparty when an invoice is rejected, its due date and when it was fully paid. Invoices are presumed accepted if not rejected. The state uses the data "con el objetivo prioritario de monitorizar los plazos de pago". Late payers become visible.
evidence:
- Recipient duties and the presumption of acceptance. — [Derecho y Abogados, 5 Oct 2026](https://www.derechoabogados.es/noticias/orden-hac-1028-2026-solucion-publica-facturacion-electronica-boe/)
- Monitoring purpose. — [BOE Orden HAC/1028/2026](https://www.boe.es/boe/dias/2026/10/05/pdfs/BOE-A-2026-20587.pdf)
- 4-calendar-day window (single-source). — [B2Brouter](https://www.b2brouter.net/es/plazos-obligatoriedad-factura-electronica-b2b/)
- Phasing. — [AEAT, 7 Oct 2026](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/todas-noticias/2026/octubre/7/solucion-publica-facturacion-electronica.html)
scale: All B2B buyers; no count found.
cost_impact: A new recurring AP process. Reputational and enforcement exposure for late payers (overlaps with the late-payment researcher). Not quantified.
driver_status: Ley 18/2022, RD 238/2026 art. 12, Orden HAC/1028/2026. Upcoming.
solved_today: Not solved yet. ERPs and e-invoice platforms are only starting to build status workflows.
software_solvable: Yes. Bank-feed-driven payment-date reporting, AP approval and rejection workflows, and bulk reporting by asesorías.
confidence: High on the rules; low on cost.

title: Software lock-in, vendor consolidation and paywalled support
who: SMEs, autónomos and asesorías using invoicing and accounting SaaS.
where: National.
reality:
- Switching vendors risks losing linked documents and data, and records must be kept 4–6 years.
- Phone support and escalation are often limited to premium plans or extra fees.
- Regulatory updates arrive as upsells.
- Ownership is concentrating in a few groups.
evidence:
- Lock-in and portability limits under RD 238/2026; CNMC cloud analysis of 16 Sep 2026. — [AyE, 15 Oct 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/autonomos/factura-electronica-pone-alerta-autonomos-control-datos/20261015000100056311.html)
- Holded: phone support Premium-only; €50 extra for support; "nuevas obligaciones fiscales te las hace pagar"; account deletion difficulties. — [Trustpilot Holded 1-star](https://es.trustpilot.com/review/holded.com?stars=1)
- TeamSystem branding on Quipu, Billin and DELSOL. — [Quipu](https://getquipu.com/es); [Billin](https://www.billin.net/precios/); [Contasol](https://www.sdelsol.com/programa-contabilidad-contasol/)
- Visma/Holded (2021, about €120M). — [Wikipedia Holded](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Holded)
- Contasimple by Shine. — [Contasimple](https://www.contasimple.com/precios)
scale: Holded more than 80,000 customers (2021); Quipu more than 20,000; FacturaScripts more than 7,200 (vendor claims).
cost_impact: Switching costs and time; paid support add-ons (€50 example).
driver_status: Market force: M&A consolidation plus regulatory-driven upgrade cycles. Ongoing.
solved_today: Exports to Excel; asesoría-held copies; open-source alternatives (FacturaScripts).
software_solvable: Yes. Vendor-neutral archives (UBL/Facturae plus PDF/A), migration tools, multi-vendor connectors.
confidence: Medium. Complaints are anecdotal; consolidation is observed.

title: Basque TicketBAI/Batuz: real-time invoice reporting, adaptation costs and constant technical churn
who: All businesses in Álava, Bizkaia and Gipuzkoa. Retail, hospitality, repairs, hairdressing and other personal services were phased last; older sole traders and estancos needed exemptions.
where: Regional: Bilbao and Bizkaia, Vitoria-Gasteiz and Álava, Donostia-San Sebastián and Gipuzkoa.
reality: Every ticket and invoice is signed, carries a TBAI QR, and is sent to the Hacienda Foral. In Bizkaia, individuals and companies also keep online LROE books (140/240). Vendors must keep up with schema and certificate changes, such as the SSL chain change of 24 Nov 2026.
evidence:
- Bizkaia phased calendar 2024–2026; 30% deduction; 10% compensation. — [Batuz](http://www.batuz.eus/es/implantacion-definitiva)
- Gipuzkoa enforceable for all from 1 Jun 2023. — [Gipuzkoa calendario](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/es/web/ogasuna/ticketbai/calendario)
- Deductions of 30% or 60% (cap €5,000 and 1% of turnover), and worked examples of €1,200 (bar), €1,700 (physio) and €2,500 (SL). — [Gipuzkoa deducciones](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/es/web/ogasuna/ticketbai/deducciones)
- Exemptions for those aged 60+ and a 5-year partial exemption for vending and estancos. — [Gipuzkoa exoneraciones](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/es/web/ogasuna/ticketbai/exoneraciones)
- Álava from 1 Dec 2022 (vendor source). — [VeriBai](https://veribai.com/calendario-verifactu)
scale: All economic activity in the three territories; no count retrieved.
cost_impact: About €1,200–€2,500 per business in the official examples, partly offset by 30–60% deductions. Ongoing vendor maintenance.
driver_status: Norma Foral 3/2020 and DF 32/2020 (Gipuzkoa); Norma Foral 8/2023 (Bizkaia). **In force** (Bizkaia's final phase on 1 Jan 2026). Not affected by the VeriFactu postponement.
solved_today:
- Certified-software registries.
- Free official apps: FakturaBAI, FakturAraba, Haz tu factura.
- Vendors such as TS Facturas (TicketBAI included) and Holded (complaints about its TicketBAI API documentation).
software_solvable: Yes, and largely solved by vendors already. The residual opportunity is in multi-regime firms (TicketBAI + VeriFactu + B2B e-invoicing + LROE).
confidence: Medium-high on the rules; low on small-business outcomes (no press evidence retrieved).

title: The quarterly filing treadmill and bureaucracy hours
who: Autónomos (persona física) and micro and small companies; SLs add IS modelos 202 and 200.
where: National (common territory). The Basque Country adds LROE.
reality:
- Four times a year: VAT (303), IRPF instalments (130 or 131), withholding (111, 115) and intra-EU sales (349).
- Annually: 390, 190, 180, 347 and the Renta.
- Plus December regime choices (renouncing módulos or cash accounting).
- Many filings fall on 20 October; monthly filers have more.
evidence:
- Oct–Dec 2026 calendar. — [AyE, 21 Sep 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/autonomos-tendran-que-presentar-todavia-mas-diez-declaraciones-impuestos-antes-final-ano/20260918192006055928.html)
- 42.4% want two or one filings a year (ATA Q1 2026). — [AyE, 13 Apr 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/info-ata/barometro-ata-autonomos-ven-urgente-exencion-iva-pagar-cuota-bajas-menos-burocracia/20260410152422053054.html)
- 37.1% (end of 2025) and 92% "more bureaucracy". — [AyE, 12 Jan 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/info-ata/autonomos-demandan-exencion-iva-franquiciado-pagar-cuota-baja-reducir-declaraciones-fiscales/20260112142017047702.html)
- 226 hours a year and €3,390 (ATA, method undisclosed). — [AyE, 11 Aug 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/info-ata/ata-denuncia-que-autonomos-pierden-mas-3000-euros-costes-tramites-burocraticos/20260810150741055355.html)
- Firms spend 21.5 hours/month on manual invoicing tasks. — [MuyPymes, 20 Oct 2026](https://www.muypymes.com/2026/10/20/pymes-autonomos-confunde-verifactu-factura-electronica)
scale: 3.41M RETA members plus companies.
cost_impact: About €3,000–€3,400 a year of owner time (ATA). Gestoría fees of about €25–€130/month (Section 5).
driver_status: LIVA/RIVA, LIRPF and LGT filing rules. **In force.** No reform proposal found; ATA demands a reduction.
solved_today: Gestorías and online asesorías (€25–€100/month); software that prepares modelos (Anfix Avanzado €14.99 and up; Cuéntica Fiscalidad €29); doing it oneself on the AEAT site.
software_solvable: Partly. Preparation and filing can be fully automated from bank and invoice data (filing on the taxpayer's behalf needs AEAT collaborator status or a power of representation). Fewer filings needs a change in the law.
confidence: High that the pain exists; medium on the ATA quantification.

title: Surcharges and fixed fines for late or corrected filings ("gotcha" penalties)
who: Autónomos and micro firms, especially those filing themselves or with low-touch online services.
where: National.
reality: A filing a few days late, a missed requerimiento, an address change not reported, or correcting one's Renta after the campaign triggers automatic charges, even when no tax was lost.
evidence:
- Art. 27: 1% plus 1% per month; 15% plus interest after 12 months; 25% reduction. — [BOE LGT](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2003-23186)
- Art. 28: 5%, 10% or 20% enforcement surcharges. — [BOE LGT](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2003-23186)
- Art. 198: €200 fixed; €20 per data item (minimum €300, maximum €20,000) for informative returns; halved if voluntary. — [BOE LGT](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2003-23186)
- €100 per year for post-campaign IRPF rectification. — [AyE, 23 Oct 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/agencia-tributaria-sancionando-autonomos-rectificar-renta-recuperar-impuestos/20261022170642056497.html)
- €400 for an unreported domicile change. — [AyE, 15 Oct 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/autonomos-pueden-acabar-cuenta-embargada-hacienda-domicilio-fiscal-dia/20261015000100056315.html)
- €250–€600 for ignoring a requerimiento. — [AyE, 18 Aug 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/hacienda-enviando-cartas-autonomos-descuadres-bizum-cinco-errores-habituales/20260817095927055443.html)
- Trustpilot complaints attribute expected penalties to advisers' errors. — [Trustpilot Declarando](https://es.trustpilot.com/review/declarando.es)
scale: Not quantified; no AEAT statistics retrieved.
cost_impact: €100–€600 per incident is typical, plus percentage surcharges.
driver_status: LGT arts. 27, 28, 198 and 203 (Ley 11/2021 wording); art. 67 bis RIRPF. **In force.**
solved_today: Gestorías' calendars; vendor reminders; reviewing the case with lawyers (for example Legálitas).
software_solvable: Partly. Deadline-risk engines, auto-filing and requerimiento triage reduce incidents; disputes need professionals.
confidence: High on the rules; low on frequency.

title: No small-business VAT franchise; very small autónomos must charge and file VAT
who: Low-turnover autónomos (below €85,000 a year, the threshold ATA proposes). The ENA shows 53% contribute on bases under €1,500/month.
where: National (common territory). ATA says Canarias is moving on this, and Navarra and the Basque Country have the competence (single-source).
reality: Even micro-activities must charge VAT and file modelo 303 four times a year, plus 390.
evidence:
- 52.5% of autónomos rank a VAT exemption for those under €85,000 as their top demand (ATA Q1 2026). — [AyE, 13 Apr 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/info-ata/barometro-ata-autonomos-ven-urgente-exencion-iva-pagar-cuota-bajas-menos-burocracia/20260410152422053054.html)
- "España sigue siendo el único país de la Unión Europea que no ha traspuesto esta Directiva" (Amor). — [AyE, 12 Jan 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/info-ata/autonomos-demandan-exencion-iva-franquiciado-pagar-cuota-baja-reducir-declaraciones-fiscales/20260112142017047702.html)
- Brussels has taken Spain to the CJEU (ATA claim, single-source); the measure is tax-neutral but simplifies. — [AyE, 25 Mar 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/info-ata/lorenzo-amor-autonomos-gastan-10000-millones-ano-declarar-iva-espana-sigue-incumpliendo-ley/20260323162900052705.html)
scale: "Miles" (ATA); no official count.
cost_impact: Part of ATA's claim of more than €10,000M a year of bureaucracy cost (not explained; advocacy figure).
driver_status: EU SME VAT scheme (my background knowledge says Directive (EU) 2020/285, applicable from 2025; **not verified** in fetched sources). Spain has **not transposed** it (ATA). No Spanish bill was verified.
solved_today: Not solved. Asesorías file the 303s.
software_solvable: No (policy). Software only reduces filing effort.
confidence: Medium. All sources trace back to ATA.

title: The real-income contribution system: choosing a tramo and absorbing annual regularisation
who: About 3.41M RETA members, mostly personas físicas.
where: National. Regional "cuota cero" refunds for newcomers vary: Madrid, Andalucía, Murcia, Canarias, Aragón, Galicia and Baleares offer them; Cataluña has none open; Valencia's scheme is announced.
reality: Autónomos must forecast net income, pick one of 15 tramos (they can change up to six times a year via Import@ss), and later receive a regularisation charge or refund based on their IRPF return. Many find it opaque, and 15% do not know their tramo.
evidence:
- 2026 table: €205–€1,606/month. — [Infoautónomos, 2 Sep 2026](https://www.infoautonomos.com/seguridad-social/cuota-de-autonomos-cuanto-se-paga/)
- Regularisation outcomes: 35.1% paid, 10.4% refunded; handling rated 2.2/10; 50.3% cite lack of transparency; 51.3% prefer the old system. — [ENA 2025](https://www.infoautonomos.com/club-cursos/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/11/ESTUDIO-NACIONAL-DEL-AUTONOMO-INFOAUTONOMOS-ENA-2025.pdf)
- 2023: 295,109 placed on a €1,000 base by default. — [AyE, 5 Feb 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/info-ata/300000-autonomos-societarios-colaboradores-veran-reducidas-prestaciones-regularizacion-2023/20260204110721051762.html)
- MEI to 1% in 2027; negotiation stalled for more than a year. — [AyE, 4 Oct 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/seguridad-social/cuotas-autonomos-volveran-subir-2027-seguridad-social-actualice-tablas/20261002165252056149.html)
- Cuota cero by region. — [AyE, 11 Oct 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/seguridad-social/ccaa-que-estan-ofreciendo-cuota-cero-autonomos-2026-cuales-son-como-solicitarla/20261008190921056250.html)
scale: 3.41M; about 35% of surveyed autónomos had to pay after regularisation.
cost_impact: Cuota €205–€1,606/month. Lump-sum regularisation bills (an example €1,800 demand appears in AyE, 20 Oct 2026). Deferrals eased by RD 643/2026. — [AyE, 20 Oct 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/seguridad-social/autonomos-pequenas-deudas-tienen-ahora-mas-facil-lograr-aplazamientos-seguridad-social/20261019174524056408.html)
driver_status: RDL 13/2022 system. 2026 tables frozen (Orden PJC/297/2026, single-source). 2027: MEI 1% by law, bases pending. **In force; 2027 parameters pending.**
solved_today: Gestorías and graduados sociales; vendor calculators (Cuéntica's autónomo-fee calculator in its €19 plan); manual Import@ss changes.
software_solvable: Partly. Continuous income-to-tramo tracking, regularisation-exposure forecasts and assisted base changes (needs Seguridad Social authorisation or RED access). The policy design is not software-solvable.

title: Societarios and family collaborators: 2026 minimum-base hike and future lump-sum regularisation
who: Autónomos who own or run their own SL (societarios) and family collaborators: about 1.2M affected, 500,000–600,000 feeling the impact.
where: National.
reality: Their minimum base rose from €1,000 to €1,424 in 2026, while everyone else's tables were frozen. The TGSS does not update bases automatically, so those who do not act now will face a back-charge in 2027–2028. The 2023 regularisation also cut future benefits for about 300,000 people placed on the €1,000 default base.
evidence:
- +~40%, more than €130/month, more than €1,600/year; regularisation in 2027–28. — [AyE, 13 Apr 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/info-ata/ata-pide-gobierno-que-rectifique-paralice-subida-cuotas-directa-mas-medio-millon-autonomos/20260413121353053066.html)
- €1,424 base, +42% (about €135/month), 1.2M affected, graduados sociales working "a contrarreloj". — [AyE, 13 May 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/info-ata/seguridad-social-empuja-miles-autonomos-cambiar-cuotas-futuras-regularizaciones/20260512112256053643.html)
- 300,000 with reduced benefits; ATA estimates a revenue hole of more than €500M. — [AyE, 5 Feb 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/info-ata/300000-autonomos-societarios-colaboradores-veran-reducidas-prestaciones-regularizacion-2023/20260204110721051762.html)
- All ATA-sourced.
scale: 1.2M (base change); 500,000–600,000 (cuota impact).
cost_impact: About €1,600+/year per person, potentially charged in one go.
driver_status: 2026 cotización order (March 2026) linked to the SMI. A Junts proposición de ley to stop it was pending in May 2026 (outcome not verified). **In force; regularisation upcoming.**
solved_today: Gestorías and graduados sociales manually raising bases; ATA lobbying.
software_solvable: Partly (alerts, exposure calculators, bulk base management for asesorías). The rule itself is policy.

title: Módulos (estimación objetiva) legal uncertainty, year after year
who: Autónomos in módulos: bars and cafés, goods transport (Fenadismer), taxis and small retail, plus about 800,000 farmers.
where: National (common territory); foral regimes differ.
reality: Each winter, módulos users do not know whether the €250,000/€125,000 limits will be extended, or whether they must switch to estimación directa (full books, possibly higher tax) before the first instalment on 20 April. Renuncia deadlines move.
evidence:
- RDL 16/2025 and RDL 2/2026 not convalidated (Congress resolution 26 Feb 2026); renuncia deadline 16 Feb 2026. — [AEAT, 9 Feb 2026](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/todas-noticias/2026/febrero/9/medidas-materia-tributacion.html)
- The DGT keeps the "límites… vigentes en los ejercicios 2016 a 2024" for 2026. — [AEAT note, 1 Apr 2026](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/todas-noticias/2026/abril/1/nota-sobre-efectos-ambito-tributario-febrero.html)
- Fenadismer: "enorme inseguridad jurídica". — [AyE, 5 Feb 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/autonomos/gobierno-vuelve-enviar-real-decreto-congreso-intentar-mantener-limites-modulos-2026/20260204100336051760.html)
- The 2027 draft order does not extend the limits. — [AyE, 23 Oct 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/haciende-quiere-mantener-modulos-autonomos-2027-acaba-lanzar-orden-condiciones/20261022175024056502.html)
- Módulos users who invoice with software are also caught by VeriFactu. — [AyE, 24 Aug 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/miles-autonomos-deberan-cambiar-programas-facturacion-estan-uno-cuatro-supuestos/20260821125529055525.html)
scale: "Miles" in hospitality, transport and retail; about 800,000 farmers. No total found.
cost_impact: Possible forced move to estimación directa; advisory hours; AEAT controls on módulos limits. — [AyE, 20 Aug 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/hacienda-volvera-enviar-miles-cartas-autonomos-partir-septiembre-errores-renta/20260819154220055494.html)
driver_status: LIRPF transitional limits extended yearly by RDL. **2026 resolved by DGT interpretation; 2027 limits pending** a norm with legal rank. Draft order for 2027 in audiencia pública (Oct 2026).
solved_today: Gestorías. Online asesorías often exclude módulos (TaxDown Standard). — [TaxDown](https://taxdown.es/autonomos)
software_solvable: Partly. Módulos-vs-directa simulators and limit monitoring; the legal uncertainty is political.

title: Card and Bizum data matching (modelo 170 monthly) triggers letters to B2C businesses
who: B2C autónomos and micro firms: hospitality, dental and vet clinics, hairdressers, retail (including recargo de equivalencia), taxis and passenger transport.
where: National (common territory).
reality: Since January 2026, banks report every business card and Bizum collection monthly. Refunds across quarters, tips, personal Bizum into a business number, third-party collections and exempt services create mismatches with modelo 303, and the AEAT sends letters. Owners must reconcile "operación por operación y pago por pago".
evidence: Modelo 170 monthly since 1 Jan 2026 (RD 253/2025; Orden HAC/747/2025), no threshold, five common mismatches, €250–€600 fine for ignoring a requerimiento (single press source citing the norms). — [AyE, 18 Aug 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/hacienda-enviando-cartas-autonomos-descuadres-bizum-cinco-errores-habituales/20260817095927055443.html). Personal Bizum can be treated as business income (headline only, not read). — [AyE Hacienda listing, 16 Oct 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/hacienda/). The card-versus-cash mix is used in post-campaign checks. — [AyE, 20 Aug 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/hacienda-volvera-enviar-miles-cartas-autonomos-partir-septiembre-errores-renta/20260819154220055494.html)
scale: Every business accepting cards or Bizum; no letter count found.
cost_impact: Reconciliation hours; fines for non-response; possible reassessments.
driver_status: RD 253/2025 and Orden HAC/747/2025 (as reported). **In force since 1 Jan 2026.**
solved_today: Manual reconciliation by owners or gestorías. Separate business and personal Bizum on expert advice.
software_solvable: Yes. Ingest POS, acquirer and Bizum data, reconcile against invoices and 303 bases, and produce explanation packs for the AEAT.
confidence: Medium (one press source; the mechanism is plausible and specific).

title: Post-Renta letters, requerimientos and data cross-checks
who: Autónomos (estimación directa and módulos) and small firms.
where: National.
reality: From September, the AEAT sends "miles de cartas". They flag income reported by clients but not declared, retenciones mismatches, unproven expenses (vehicle, phone, promotion) and sector-ratio outliers. A requerimiento can also ask for invoices to check someone else's taxes. The response deadline is short and documents must be at hand.
evidence:
- Gestha on letter waves and cross-checks; 4-year window. — [AyE, 20 Aug 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/hacienda-volvera-enviar-miles-cartas-autonomos-partir-septiembre-errores-renta/20260819154220055494.html)
- "Un requerimiento de información no equivale a una inspección"; art. 93 LGT third-party requests. — [AyE, 14 Sep 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/autonomos-verifactu-tendran-mas-probabilidad-recibir-cartas-hacienda-septiembre/20260911111536055824.html)
- The Labour Inspectorate sends more data to Hacienda (headline only). — [AyE Hacienda listing](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/hacienda/)
scale: "Miles" (no official number).
cost_impact: Hours of document gathering; adjustments plus interest; sanctions (50% under art. 191 as a starting point; 15% or 50% for improper refunds). — [AyE, 23 Oct 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/agencia-tributaria-sancionando-autonomos-rectificar-renta-recuperar-impuestos/20261022170642056497.html)
driver_status: LGT verification procedures; third-party data (modelos 170, 171, 347, 190). **In force.**
solved_today: Gestorías and tax lawyers; Legálitas-type services.
software_solvable: Partly. A document vault and a requerimiento-response kit (auto-assemble invoices, bank proofs, a deductibility rationale). Representation is still human.

title: Uncertainty over deductible expenses (car, phone, meals, home office) and documentation
who: Autónomos in estimación directa: professionals, trades, freelancers working from home.
where: National.
reality: Owners do not know which expenses will survive a check or what proof to keep. Home-office utilities are limited to 30% of the floor-area share; vehicles and meals are frequently disputed; the burden of proof is on the taxpayer.
evidence:
- The Consejo para la Defensa del Contribuyente says the rules are "excesivamente restrictivas", reports recurring complaints, and proposes objective rules. — [AyE, 20 Oct 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/hacienda-admite-que-autonomos-tienen-demasiadas-trabas-deducir-coche-movil-comidas-suministros/20261019135900056391.html)
- Unproven expenses are a typical letter trigger. — [AyE, 20 Aug 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/hacienda-volvera-enviar-miles-cartas-autonomos-partir-septiembre-errores-renta/20260819154220055494.html)
- 24% of autónomos want legal certainty on deductions (ATA end-2025 barometer). — [AyE, 12 Jan 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/info-ata/autonomos-demandan-exencion-iva-franquiciado-pagar-cuota-baja-reducir-declaraciones-fiscales/20260112142017047702.html)
scale: Most of the roughly 3.4M autónomos in estimación directa (inference).
cost_impact: Over-paying out of caution, or reassessments and sanctions. Not quantified.
driver_status: LIRPF and LIVA deduction rules and TEAC doctrine. The Consejo's proposals are **not adopted** (report only).
solved_today: Gestoría advice. Vendor features: Declarando's "recomendador de deducibles" (Pro plan €69.90 with taxes); receipt scanning (TaxDown 30–100 scans a month; Quipu 30–350).
software_solvable: Partly. Evidence-grade expense capture plus rules engines help; the legal ambiguity remains.

title: Notification traps leading to apremio and embargo
who: Companies (obliged to receive electronic notifications) and autónomos who are obliged or have opted in; anyone with a stale address.
where: National.
reality: An electronic notification counts as delivered after 10 days unopened, even without an email alert. After failed postal attempts, notice goes to the BOE. Owners find out when the account is embargoed.
evidence: The 10-day rule; BOE edicts after two failed attempts with 15 days to appear; €400 fine for not updating the domicile; surcharges of up to 20%; AN sentencia 489/2026. — [AyE, 15 Oct 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/autonomos-pueden-acabar-cuenta-embargada-hacienda-domicilio-fiscal-dia/20261015000100056315.html)
scale: Not quantified.
cost_impact: Surcharges of 5–20% (art. 28 LGT), embargos, lost appeal windows. — [BOE LGT](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2003-23186)
driver_status: LGT notification rules and Ley 39/2015. **In force.**
solved_today: Gestorías monitoring mailboxes on clients' behalf; personal vigilance.
software_solvable: Yes. Unified monitoring of AEAT, DEHú and TGSS mailboxes with triage and deadline alerts (needs certificate or representation delegation).

title: Faster embargos and debt enforcement (24-hour bank embargos, embargoed refunds, Seguridad Social deferrals)
who: Autónomos and micro firms with tax or Social Security debts.
where: National.
reality: From autumn 2026, an AEAT embargo order issued in the evening can freeze funds before 08:00 the next morning, across up to 10 accounts at the same bank including neobanks. Refunds owed can be diverted to court-ordered embargos. Social Security deferrals are easier, but plans are cancelled after missed payments (headline only).
evidence:
- Resolución of 4 Jun 2026 on 24-hour embargos (single-source). — [AyE, 22 Aug 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/hacienda-podra-embargar-cuentas-bancarias-autonomos-menos-24-horas-partir-septiembre/20260821085621055511.html)
- TEAC RG 00/51764/2026 (embargoed refunds). — [AyE, 22 Oct 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/hacienda-puede-embargar-devoluciones-impuestos-autonomos-teac-abre-via-reclamar/20261019170607056403.html)
- RD 643/2026 on Social Security deferrals. — [AyE, 20 Oct 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/seguridad-social/autonomos-pequenas-deudas-tienen-ahora-mas-facil-lograr-aplazamientos-seguridad-social/20261019174524056408.html)
- Fraccionamiento cancelled after three missed monthly payments (headline only). — [AyE Seguridad Social listing](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/seguridad-social/)
scale: Not quantified.
cost_impact: Frozen working capital; surcharges of 5–20% (LGT art. 28); interest.
driver_status: LGT collection rules and the AEAT resolution (in force, roll-out until Nov 2026); RD 643/2026 (in force 1 Aug 2026).
solved_today: Gestorías and lawyers; online aplazamiento requests.
software_solvable: Partly. Debt early warning, automated aplazamiento applications and cash-flow buffers. Enforcement itself is not.

title: VAT cash-flow drag: VAT on unpaid invoices and slow or blocked refunds
who: B2B autónomos and SMEs with slow-paying or insolvent customers; exporters and travellers paying foreign VAT.
where: National.
reality:
- VAT is paid on invoices that have not been collected. Recovering it requires formal modification of the taxable base and rectificativas within strict deadlines.
- Quarterly filers can reclaim VAT credits only in January.
- Foreign VAT takes at least four months to come back.
- Refunds can be embargoed.
evidence:
- TEAC RG 00/07774/2024 (22 Sep 2026). — [AyE, 10 Oct 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/muchos-autonomos-podran-recuperar-iva-facturas-rectificativas-hayan-enviado-tarde/20261009173758056270.html)
- Q4-only refunds; modelo 360 and four-month response time. — [AyE, 28 Sep 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/autonomos-tienen-solo-cinco-dias-cobrar-iva-ventas-que-hicieron-fuera-espana/20260925172623056019.html)
- Embargoed refunds. — [AyE, 22 Oct 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/hacienda-puede-embargar-devoluciones-impuestos-autonomos-teac-abre-via-reclamar/20261019170607056403.html)
scale: Not quantified (late-payment scale is covered by the cash-flow researcher).
cost_impact: Working capital tied up for months; VAT lost when procedures are missed.
driver_status: LIVA art. 80 base modification and refund rules (not verified in the BOE here). **In force.**
solved_today: Gestorías; REDEME monthly refunds for some; the cash-accounting regime (criterio de caja), which can be opted into by 31 Dec. — [AyE, 21 Sep 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/autonomos-tendran-que-presentar-todavia-mas-diez-declaraciones-impuestos-antes-final-ano/20260918192006055928.html)
software_solvable: Partly. Deadline tracking for base modification, auto-generated rectificativas and evidence packs, regime simulators (caja, REDEME).

title: Bookkeeping and annual-accounts compliance for micro-SLs (and the sanction tail)
who: Micro and small SLs, startups, and autónomos who must keep libros registro.
where: National.
reality: SLs must keep accounts, approve and deposit annual accounts within a month, and file IS modelos 200 and 202. Errors in libros registro can lead to sanctions of up to 150% if fraud is proven. Missing the accounts deposit blocks registry filings and risks fines from the accounting regulator (ICAC).
evidence:
- LSC arts. 279, 282 and 283: fines of €1,200–€60,000, up to €300,000 for turnover above €6M; 50% reduction if filed before proceedings. — [BOE LSC](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2010-10544)
- 150% sanction requires proof of intent (TEAC, 22 Sep 2026). — [AyE, 28 Sep 2026](https://www.autonomosyemprendedor.es/articulo/hacienda/hacienda-puede-sancionar-150-autonomos-llevar-libros-debe-probar-fraude/20260925183744056027.html)
scale: Number of SLs not retrieved.
cost_impact: Accounting services €59.95–€129/month (Infoautónomos pymes, Cuéntica Contabilidad Tutelada); software with IS modelos from €58.33–€69.99/month (Anfix Empresarial). — [Infoautónomos pymes](https://www.infoautonomos.com/asesoria/pymes/); [Cuéntica](https://cuentica.com/precios/); [Anfix](https://www.anfix.com/precios)
driver_status: LSC, Código de Comercio, LGT. **In force.**
solved_today: Gestorías and asesorías; desktop accounting (Contasol, a3) and cloud accounting.
software_solvable: Yes for bookkeeping automation and accounts preparation; partly for legal deposit (it needs signatures and approval).
confidence: Medium. The law is high-confidence; how often firms fail is unknown.

title: Dependence on gestorías and online asesorías, with costly service failures
who: Most autónomos and micro firms; about 58% are willing to outsource accounting and tax.
where: National. Online models exclude some regions (TAX-25).
reality: Owners pay €25–€130/month, yet still chase answers, re-explain cases to different agents, and sometimes bear penalties from adviser errors, such as a wrong alta or a missed fraccionamiento denial.
evidence:
- Prices. — [Infoautónomos](https://www.infoautonomos.com/asesoria/); [Declarando](https://declarando.es/precios); [TaxDown](https://taxdown.es/autonomos); [Cuéntica](https://cuentica.com/precios/)
- Complaints: Declarando 25% one-star — [Trustpilot Declarando](https://es.trustpilot.com/review/declarando.es); TaxDown 12% one-star — [Trustpilot TaxDown](https://es.trustpilot.com/review/taxdown.es)
- Outsourcing willingness 57.9% and 57.2%, slightly down. — [ENA 2025](https://www.infoautonomos.com/club-cursos/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/11/ESTUDIO-NACIONAL-DEL-AUTONOMO-INFOAUTONOMOS-ENA-2025.pdf)
